answer: Agents scale to 1,000 unique identities by reserving physical service capacity on a distributed grid. A central verifier audits each lotus-shaped reservation slot to ensure occupancy by one agent only, denying overlapping requests. Like a deep canyon dividing signal paths, each slot enforces isolation via real-time latency checks. An honest node pays 1x cost, while fakes pay 1,000x for isolated slots. A raven-like monitor triggers identity revocation upon collision.
